notes.title: UPCOMING RELEASE
notes.content:
On the 18th I plan to come out of Early Access and officially release Axium's box.

I have enjoyed working on Axium's Box but the truth is there is not much more I can add to it or change.
There will be one last update on launch date and barring any major bugs that will be it for the time being.

If there is anything you think should be changed or added before the launch please let me know :)

notes.title: More bug fixes.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed achievements![/b] They now work properly on Steam!

notes.title: Minor Bug fixes
notes.content:
Primarily fixed world bounds.
Fixed damage reactions.
And various refinements

notes.title: Major Overhaul
notes.content:
A complete overhaul from sound to animations, and everything in between.

[list]
[*] Falling too far or taking too much damage can cause the player to ragdoll
[*] The player can ragdoll at will with a hidden key.
[*] When taking damage the player now has a physical reaction.
[*] Some 3d models have been remade or replaced with high poly versions.
[*] Many objects now play sounds when the character is close to them.
[*] The ground floor has new animated textures.
[*] Most cosmetics have improved textures.
[*] Game physics has been reworked.
[*] Just lightly taping the jump button now results in a smaller jump.
[*] Fixed many vaulting bugs.
[*] Charged gravity spell now has sounds and particle effects when used.
[*] Jump pads now have sounds and particle effects when used.
[*] Powerups now have sounds and particle effects when received. 
[*] High jumps now have their own animation.
[*] While doing a double jump the player may do a flip.
[*] Falling now has a few more animations.
[*] Wall-run is easier to activate and has a slight up force attached to it.
[*] Wall-run animations have completely been redone.
[*] Swinging animations have completely been redone.
[*] Leaving world bounds instant jibs you now.
[*] And many other small changes that improve the look and feel of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: Step UP!
notes.content:
Grab the ledge, you idiot! ːsteammockingː

One of the biggest frustrations in platformers, including my own, is the tendency for characters to fall even if they make contact with a ledge. As a kid, I used to yell at the screen, telling my character they could have just reached out and grabbed the ledge.

So, in my game, I decided to fix this issue. Now, if your character is close enough to a ledge and not too low when you hit the jump button, they will reach out and pull themselves up.

While this tweak does make the game easier, it also adds a smoother and more satisfying gameplay experience. So, grab that ledge, and don't fall all the way back down!

notes.title: Photo Mode!
notes.content:
After Optimizing I was able to crank up my graphics setting and I kept thinking to myself "I Wish there was an easier way to get better pictures."

So I went ahead and made one Muhahahah! 

Introducing the revolutionary new Photo Mode! With just a few clicks, you can detach your camera from your avatar and explore your game world in a whole new way. Fly freely through the world and adjust the flow of time to capture that perfect screenshot with ease. Say goodbye to the frustration of trying to snap the perfect shot and hello to the Photo Mode, the ultimate solution for gamers looking to up their screenshot game.

notes.title: Major optimization!
notes.content:
I have extensively reviewed and optimized the game's code and shaders, resulting in improved performance. This optimization process included identifying and fixing bugs, streamlining the shaders, and implementing new optimization techniques to enhance the game's overall efficiency.

Players can expect to see a significant boost in the game's FPS, with an estimated improvement ranging from 15-30 FPS. This increase in FPS means that the game will run more smoothly and seamlessly, providing a more immersive and enjoyable gaming experience.

The optimization should help machines or computers with lower-end specifications run the game even on "Epic" without falling below 30 FPS. :)
